quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are trying to enter a one-way street going the wrong way.
You can proceed if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are trying to enter a one-way street going the wrong way.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong way and may crash head-on with other cars. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: This sign shows what type of road feature?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always blow your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross safely. Stay alert when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. You may see several of these signs through a curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead is now divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, pay attention, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead has one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead fits only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow for you to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow for you to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the bridge may not be wide enough to pass a truck. Be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you to drive carefully when the road is wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that traffic may come from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black and alert drivers to road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Get ready to allow traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield when turning left on green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield when turning left on green.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left at a green light, they must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a road has one-way traffic. You must not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and other traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and other traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and check for pedestrians and traffic. Wait until it is safe to proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves only to the right.
The road turns sharply to the right.
The road curves right and then curves left.
The road curves left and then curves right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right and then curves left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs tell you about hazards ahead. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road curves right and then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: It warns about conditions on or near the road.
It shows directions to cities and towns ahead.
It tells you about traffic laws and rules.
It tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs tell you about hazards on or near the road. They are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When your left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it means you plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road turns sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. A flagger controls traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed to drive when exiting a highway. For example, it may show 30 mph.

questions.question: At a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to traffic on the right.
Yield just to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for road hazards ahead. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that there is not much space above the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is an intersection ahead and a road will join from the right.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. These lanes are for buses and cars with the driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a divided highway begins ahead. The road splits into separate one-way roads. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Stop completely, then go if it is safe.
Go through carefully, but you may not need to stop.
Stop only if traffic is on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go if it is safe.
questions.explanation: You must always come to a complete stop at a stop sign. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must bear right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Two lanes of opposite traffic are merging.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the bridge ahead has low clearance. Do not go through if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people entering or crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: This sign shows what?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill section ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop, so you must yield to them.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The right road is one-way only.
Slow down for a sharp turn ahead.
A crossroad is to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down for a sharp turn ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead turns sharply (in this case, to the right). Slow down as you would for a turn at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter the road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road makes a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells drivers to slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Yield to other drivers and pedestrians. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right or go straight.
You may turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you can either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before going.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign warns of a winding road. Slow down and adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign means a steep hill is coming. Slow down and be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a winding road with three or more curves is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep downhill grade is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill stretch is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Be ready for red, yellow, or green lights and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A group is cleaning up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign means workers may be on or very close to the road. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the divided highway is about to end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the beginning of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp left turn is ahead.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through the middle means the action is prohibited. U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it rains.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, hand signals help riders communicate. When the lead rider holds their left arm out straight with palm up and swings it upward, it means all riders should go faster.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What is the order of traffic light colors from bottom to top?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are ordered from bottom to top as green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals tell other drivers your intentions when turn signals are not available. When your left arm is straight out to the side, it means you plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does this hand signal mean?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders in a group communicate. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points one finger up, it means the group should form a single line of riders.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a roundabout is ahead. Enter at a low speed and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to stay on the right side of the road to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or go straight through.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you do it quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. Drivers must obey all regulatory signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet and you may lose control.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right. Slow down to the safe speed shown, which is 35 mph.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm out straight with palm down and swings it down to their side, riders following should slow down.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on or crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means an action is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. You must stop and let others go if they have the right-of-way. Proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: There is a side road ahead.
Stay to the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It warns that an island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must keep to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after you stop completely.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show laws that you must obey. Where this sign is posted, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The safest speed you can drive in good weather and road conditions.
The safest speed in all weather and road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safest speed you can drive in good weather and road conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You should drive slower when conditions are bad, such as poor weather or wet roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop completely.

questions.question: What should you worry about most when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will not align properly because your car will be tilted.
A tire could be damaged if you drift onto the shoulder.
You could hydroplane if the shoulder is wet.
You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If a wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a traffic light at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if another car is coming.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: You must come to a full stop at a stop sign. Let cars and pedestrians cross first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at the exact speed shown.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the maximum legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic from other directions.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is always on top and green is always on bottom. On a horizontal traffic light, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you which direction traffic flows on a one-way street. You must drive in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Always stop completely at this intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is coming up.

questions.question: You see a merging traffic sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Honk at traffic entering the highway.
Keep driving at your current speed.
Speed up to avoid traffic problems.
Change lanes if safe to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes if safe to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When you see merging traffic, make room for entering vehicles. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let traffic merge in.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending. If you are in the right lane, you must merge left with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: People are walking along the road.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Slow down and watch for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is coming from both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and let other traffic pass. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing downward, it means the rider is slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: Can continue through or exit from your lane.
Can stay in your lane and continue through.
Must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will leave the highway. You must exit if you stay in that lane, or change lanes to continue on the highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is entering from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. In this case, a right turn is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals when turn signals are not available. A left arm bent at the elbow and pointing upward means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down and avoid sudden braking or sharp turns. Keep more distance from the vehicle in front of you.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get caught on the tracks.

questions.question: When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider's left arm is extended straight out, it is a hand signal that means they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that parking is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles often cross or ride beside traffic here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that a sharp turn is coming and they should reduce their speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers to an upcoming steep hill. Slow down to prevent brake damage or collisions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: This orange sign warns drivers that construction work is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through the work area.
